limits: Counts describe the complete captured log, not every historical log.
Item override warnings name the item, not the winning pack; ownership requires T1.7/T1.10.
Watchdog messages do not prove a root cause or client rendering/performance.
Mixed material warning does not identify the block.
Initialization notices are still preserved as engine warning-level records.

limitations: Snapshot covers installed bytes and enabled order, not effective precedence of merged JSON definitions.
Vanilla entity ownership is collected from BP entities; valid version-overlay fragments without an identifier are listed separately.
RP client player/controller interactions and private Grilling overlap decisions are separate T1.9 work.
This does not establish LKG-0, offline census, staging entry, native validation, deployment or human acceptance.
